# Description of the Screen Recording

## 1) What app/interface is shown
This is a **camera/screen recording of a video being played** (note the video player controls: pause button, timestamp ~0:00/0:38, mute icon, and thumbnail strip at the bottom — appears to be a phone gallery or social media video player). The video itself shows:
- A **physical Android phone** (Samsung, dark wallpaper with circular punch-hole camera) standing in front of a **Dell laptop**, running what appears to be **MetaTrader 4/5 mobile app** (the "Trade" screen with Balance/Equity/Free margin layout is characteristic of MT4/MT5).
- The **laptop screen** shows a web-based trading bot dashboard in a browser (Opera), with URL containing something like "Downloads/Quetta Trader GOLD Simulation 1..."
- The video is watermarked "**Live bot trading**" in red diagonal text and "**@ABDUL915252**" (Instagram handle) — clearly promotional content for a trading bot service.

## 2) UI layout, colors, design
- **Phone (MT app):** White/light background, minimal dark text. Top bar labeled "Trade" with a hamburger menu. Lists Balance, Equity, Free margin. Bottom navigation with ~5 tabs (Quotes, Charts, Trade, History, Messages) — the Trade tab is active with a red badge notification on the last icon.
- **Laptop dashboard:** Dark/black theme with yellow/gold accents (fitting the "GOLD" trading theme), green (+profit) and red (SELL/loss) text. A yellow-highlighted "Trades" tab at the bottom nav. Top banner frame 1 shows a crown icon with "QUETTA TRADER" VIP badge, a large "$1.00" balance in yellow, "+$0.00" in green, "247" stat, Instagram logo, and an "Auto Bot / Bot Send Bot / Turbo Mode 0M +60 Sec Close" panel with a "Paused" status.
- **Surroundings:** Dell laptop keyboard, browser bookmarks bar (Booking.com, Amazon, eBay, Facebook, YouTube), Windows taskbar, Opera browser.

## 3) Trading features visible
- **MT mobile app:** Account metrics (Balance, Equity, Free margin), open positions list with symbol **XAUUSDm** (gold, Exness-style "m" suffix), lot size **sell 0.01**, entry/exit prices (e.g., 4 354.619 → 4 354.941), and per-trade P/L (-0.32, -0.26, -0.25 etc.). Tab badge shows growing open-trade count (0 → 5 → 05).
- **Bot dashboard:** "ACTIVE TRADES" feed with entries like "**XAUUSD/GOLD BUY $50 + $104.14 (CLOSED In 32s)**", "XAUUSD/GOLD BUY $50 +$293.26 (CLOSED In 46s)", BUY/SELL signals with confidence-like percentages ("95% win... $2153.43"), "$50" stake rows with gold/yellow progress bars, "+$11.36 / +$27.23" green profits, countdowns ("8s Left", "7s Left", "56s Left"), and bottom nav: Home, Bot, Trades, Update, Settings.
- Essentially an **automated gold trading bot** (Turbo Mode, auto open/close in ~30–60 sec) mirrored across web dashboard and MT4/5 mobile.

## 4) Language & key texts
All in **English**: "Live bot trading", "QUETTA TRADER", "Balance / Equity / Free margin", "XAUUSDm sell 0.01", "Auto Bot", "Turbo Mode 0M +60 Sec Close", "Paused", "ACTIVE TRADES", "BUY $50", "CLOSED In 32s", "Bot Send Bot", "@ABDUL915252". Phone status bar shows Urdu/Arabic-script text (Pakistani user). Player timestamp counts in Urdu numerals (۰:۰۰ / ۰:۳۸).

## 5) Flow / changes across frames
1. **Frame 1 (0:00):** Bot dashboard intro — $1.00 balance, Auto Bot "Paused", Instagram watermark on dashboard.
2. **Frame 2 (~0:10):** Dashboard scrolled to "ACTIVE TRADES" — closed winning trades (+$104, +$293) and new BUY/SELL signals; a finger appears reaching toward the laptop; phone still shows flat 1.00/1.00/1.00 account.
3. **Frame 3 (~0:16):** Dashboard in "Trades" tab with $50 stake rows and SELL countdowns; phone now shows an **open XAUUSDm sell 0.01 trade at -0.25**, equity dropped to 0.75 — trades now firing live.
4. **Frame 4 (~0:22):** Phone balance jumped to **5.07/5.07** (position closed in profit); dashboard shows BUY/SELL rows with green +$11–24 profits.
5. **Frame 5 (~0:27):** Phone balance now **23.70**, five stacked XAUUSDm sell positions each slightly negative (-0.26/-0.32); dashboard shows multiple $50 trades running with timers. 

**Overall narrative:** the video portrays a $1 account being rapidly grown (~$1 → ~$23) by an automated XAUUSD "Turbo" bot placing quick 30–60 second gold trades, advertised via Instagram (@ABDUL915252) — a format typical of bot-selling/giveaway promotion videos, with profits that appear selectively curated between shots.
